item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 04/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The cold front over inland Guangdong will move across and bring showers to the coastal areas between tonight to tomorrow morning. There may be thunderstorms over the inland areas. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon associated with the cold front, the weather will be slightly cooler over Guangdong in the following couple of days. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will become cold progressively and there will be a few rain patches over the region. Under the influence of a relatively dry continental airstream, the weather over the coast of southern China will improve gradually during the Lunar New Year holidays.
